common: Use seed 261029 and synthetic tenants A/B; resolve fixture IDs per case.

cases.title: Privacy
actions: Exercise subject export/erasure with a financial legal hold and review the incident timeline in a tabletop.
Use a controlled business clock for financial-year end 2026-12-31 Asia/Jakarta: attempt purge immediately before and at 2037-01-01T00:00:00+07:00; use a leap-year fiscal boundary as a second vector.

Race an authorized legal-hold insertion against purge; offboard an ended tenant after 180 days; attempt to reduce ledger.retention_years to 9; restore a backup containing previously erased nonfinancial data into an isolated recovery environment.

Run a synthetic incident with first credible signal T0, processor knowledge at T0, delayed controller acknowledgment, a weekend boundary, late discovery of an earlier occurrence and incomplete forensics; exercise 24h escalation/draft, 48h readiness and 72h dispatch deadlines using a controlled business clock.

Send only to an isolated notification sink; inject a primary-channel failure and verify the authorized alternative, delivery audit and escalation without resetting deadlines; exercise controller and processor roles separately.

Test archive retrieval and authorized recovery of retained financial evidence/key versions; verify declared storage-location evidence and block production readiness when the legal channel/reviewer/location record is absent.

assertions.expected: Only eligible personal data is erased and the hold is explained.
Controller 3x24-hour notification requirement and processor escalation target are documented.
Formal legal sign-off remains required before the relevant release gate.

Financial records are not purge-eligible before 2036-12-31T17:00:00Z for a fiscal year ending 2026-12-31 Asia/Jakarta; eligibility at that instant still requires no hold and all other policy checks. The leap-year vector follows calendar clamping.

A value of 9 for ledger.retention_years is rejected. A policy change cannot shorten an existing retain_until. A successful hold prevents the purge effect; both operations serialize without a deletion/hold race.

Offboarding at ended_at plus 180 days preserves financial/held records and erases only eligible ordinary data. RADIUS raw accounting is not blanket-retained for ten years; invoice evidence snapshots follow financial retention.

Recovery re-applies the deletion ledger before restored data is exposed. Financial evidence and its key versions remain readable for the required retention and are not destroyed by routine backup pruning.

The processor escalation deadline is no later than T0 plus 86400 seconds and consumes part of, rather than precedes, the 259200-second controller budget. Draft/readiness/dispatch bounds are 86400/172800/259200 seconds on a continuous clock.

Delayed acknowledgment, weekend, incomplete forensics, channel retry and reviewer unavailability do not reset the incident clock. Earlier reliable occurrence information moves the internal deadline earlier and records any lateness.

Required recipients, minimum notice content and isolated sink acceptance evidence are recorded; draft or queued alone is not marked delivered. Recipient data is minimized and no foreign-tenant data or secret appears.
Missing official-channel verification, storage-location evidence or professional review blocks the corresponding production gate without claiming a statutory exemption or successful notice.
